title: Residential roofing
shortDesc: Your shingles are tired, or the ceiling already has a stain. You get a look at the house and a written estimate. One homeowner had the tear-off and new shingles finished in a day.
fullDesc: Water in the ceiling does not stay in the ceiling. You call {{phone}}. Someone looks at the house in {{city}}, then writes the estimate. Project photos show gray and brown architectural shingles on houses, lake houses, and attached homes.
heading: When the stain shows up in your ceiling
body: Another patch does not stop the next rain. You want the old shingles off before snow sits on them. Call {{phone}} and the price comes after the roof is looked at.

faq.a: Faber Roof's site says it roofs homes and businesses. Call {{phone}} about a specific house.

title: Commercial roofing
shortDesc: Your building roof is leaking over the business, or a property manager needs the job on a calendar. A commercial customer said the project finished on budget and on time.
fullDesc: A leak over a workspace does not wait for a slow week. You call {{phone}}. The photos show a crew tearing off shingles on a retail building, with underlayment and roof vents, and a standing-seam metal roof on a larger brick building. Property managers have hired {{name}} for commercial work.
highlights: On budget, from a commercial review
heading: When the roof is in the way of the business
body: You need the building dry and the date kept. A Google review from a commercial project says the team finished on budget and on time. Call {{phone}} with the address.

faq.a: The site says Faber Roof does commercial and residential roofing. Call {{phone}} with the address.

title: Shingle roofing
shortDesc: Missing shingles and a soft deck get worse every rain. You get architectural shingles like the gray and charcoal roofs in these photos. Call to confirm the product.
fullDesc: You can see the bundles on the roof and the underlayment in the yard before the new shingles go down. Finished photos show gray and dark architectural shingles on brick, stone, and sided houses. CertainTeed and Landmark Pro marks have appeared on the Faber Roof site. Confirm the product on your estimate. Call {{phone}}.
highlights: Confirm the product on your estimate
heading: When the shingles stop keeping water out
body: One homeowner said the crew tore off the old roof and reshingled it the same day. That is not a promise for every house. You call {{phone}}, someone looks, and you get the estimate.

faq.a: The current site shows CertainTeed and Landmark Pro marks. Call {{phone}} to confirm what goes on a specific roof.

title: Metal roofing
shortDesc: You want metal instead of another shingle cycle. The project photo is a standing-seam roof with skylights on a brick building. Call to ask if metal fits yours.
fullDesc: The aerial photo shows standing-seam metal panels, skylights, and a brick building. It is not a house. Call {{phone}} before you plan on that system for your building.
highlights: Confirm the system on your estimate
heading: When you want metal instead of another shingle roof
body: You see the system in the photo first. Then you ask if it belongs on your building. Call {{phone}}.

faq.a: A standing-seam metal roof is pictured on faberroof.com. Call {{phone}} to ask about your building.
